description: The file defines a Java interface named 'Signal' in the package org.eclipse.ditto.signals.base. This interface represents a service message that can carry actions, notices, or warnings, and includes methods for retrieving header information and message identifiers. It extends multiple other interfaces for JSON serialization, headers, and identification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Default method that derives the name of the signal from its type by splitting the type string at the colon ':' if present, returning the part after the colon or the entire type if no colon is found.
